businesses.name: Storyville Coffee
businesses.address: 94 Pike Street Top, floor Suite 34, Seattle, WA 98101
businesses.description: Located in the heart of Pike Place Market, Storyville Coffee offers beautiful wooden decor, comfortable seating, and views of the market and Puget Sound. It's a great spot to take a break from the crowds.
businesses.hours: 7:59 AM - 4:00 PM Monday - Thursday, 7:59 AM - 5:00 PM Friday - Sunday

businesses.name: Anchorhead Coffee
businesses.description: Anchorhead has several locations in Seattle, offering a chill vibe with plenty of seating. It's a great place to study or get work done, with friendly staff and tasty coffee.

businesses.name: Elm Coffee Roasters
businesses.description: Elm Coffee Roasters stands out as an exquisite masterpiece in Seattle's coffee scene, focusing on light roasts and offering an artisanal experience.
businesses.hours: 8 AM - 3 PM Monday - Saturday, Closed Sunday

businesses.name: Moore Coffee Shop
businesses.description: Moore Coffee Shop is a charming destination with an eclectic blend of cultural influences, featuring delightful menu items, captivating decor, and incredible latte art.
businesses.hours: 8:00 AM - 3:30 PM Wednesday, Friday, Saturday; 8:00 AM - 3:00 PM Sunday; Closed Monday, Tuesday, Thursday

businesses.name: Fremont Coffee Company
businesses.description: Fremont Coffee Company offers fair-trade organic brews in a cozy, home-like atmosphere with indoor and outdoor seating. It's known for its adorable atmosphere and good vibes.
businesses.hours: 6:00 AM - 7:00 PM Monday - Friday, 7:00 AM - 7:00 PM Saturday - Sunday

businesses.name: Ghost Alley Espresso
businesses.description: A miniature coffee shop located at Pike Place Market, known for its unique Modbar system and a charmingly haunted atmosphere.
